title: Minimum Area Rectangle
summary: Given an array of points in the X-Y plane, find the minimum area of a rectangle with sides parallel to the axes formed by these points.
statement: Given an array of points in the X-Y plane, find the minimum area of a rectangle with sides parallel to the axes formed by these points. If no such rectangle exists, return 0.
constraints: Return the minimum positive area of an axis-aligned rectangle, or zero if none exists.
hints: A rectangle is identified when a new point completes two older opposite/adjacent corners.
Store prior points in a set and test every prior diagonal candidate.
For (x,y) and (px,py), require both crossed corners and compute absolute side product.
All four corners are required and each real rectangle is eventually completed.
editorial: All four corners are required and each real rectangle is eventually completed.

tests.explanation: The four corner points at x=1,3 and y=1,3 form area four.
The narrower rectangle between x=3 and x=4 has area two.
